summary: Cooking with Poo pairs a guided walk through Khlong Toei Market with hands-on Thai cooking and a shared meal. The operator currently lists THB 2,000 per person and a morning schedule from Phrom Phong; confirm December 2026 dates when booking.
whyGo: See and learn about ingredients with a local guide, then use them in the kitchen.
The morning program includes transport from Phrom Phong, cooking, and the meal you prepare.
Operator lists daily menus with several Thai classics and says dietary needs can be accommodated.
bestFor: Food-curious visitors who enjoy markets, cooking, and a group meal.
Vegetarian or vegan guests who contact the operator about adjustments in advance.
skipIf: You need step-free access or cannot manage a market walk; accessibility details are not published.
You need a guaranteed menu or allergy-safe kitchen without prior confirmation.
duration: Plan around 4–4.5 hours door-to-door for the published 9:00am–1:00/1:30pm program; traffic and group pace can shift timing. The operator’s market walk begins around 9:15am and cooking around 10:00am.
cost: THB 2,000 per person at the operator’s current published price, payable at booking. Treat this as a current rate, not a guaranteed December 2026 quote; confirm any changes and inclusions before paying.
hours: Official morning schedule: meet at 9:00am, Monday–Saturday. The operator’s class calendar and booking page should confirm the selected December date; Sunday sessions are not listed.
bestTime: Choose the morning session for the market visit and cooler early hours. Arrive before 9:00am as the operator says it cannot wait for late arrivals.
gettingThere: Meet outside Emporium shopping mall by the PRADA sign, near Phrom Phong BTS Exit 2. Staff travel with the group to Khlong Toei Market, then return to the kitchen and drop guests back at Phrom Phong. Verify the exact pickup point in the booking confirmation.
booking: Book through the operator’s official ‘Check availability & book now’ link to Bookeo. Online booking is listed as instant-confirmation; December 2026 availability was not independently visible. Individual changes/refunds are allowed only until 7 days before class; late/no-show arrivals are not refundable or reschedulable. Review the current conditions before paying.
accessibility: No step-free access, seating, toilet, or mobility accommodation details are published. The market portion is a walking tour in an active fresh market and includes a tuk-tuk transfer. Contact the operator before booking if you have mobility, sensory, or other access needs.
practicalTips: Wear comfortable closed or secure shoes and bring water; the operator says the market walk starts promptly.
Tell the operator about vegetarian, vegan, religious, or allergy requirements before booking; its site says dietary needs can be accommodated but does not detail cross-contact controls.
Check the scheduled menu for your chosen day and ask whether substitutions are possible.
decemberNotes: The operator publishes a regular Monday–Saturday morning program, but does not state holiday closures or guarantee a December 2026 timetable. Confirm the chosen date and pickup instructions directly. Bangkok can be busy in December; allow extra time to reach Phrom Phong.
uncertainties: December 2026 inventory, holiday schedule, and price are not confirmed in the public source.
Accessibility details and the extent of dietary/allergy accommodations are not specified.
Official site photo credit names several photographers collectively; attribution for the selected individual image is unclear and reuse permission is not established.
